reuse.why: A single assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard is introduced and called by all six provider link functions, but Fintegra's link and download paths are copied from the Akahu/SimpleFin ones rather than shared, and the holder-unlinking re-writes unlinkAccount's field clearing.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the ~60-line insert/update/payee/sync/sync-event body every provider function already repeats, downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with the server URL swapped, and the db.updateAccount null-out block duplicates unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts with the link handlers, the download in accounts/sync.ts dispatch, and the server URL and provider list in their existing config/type modules.

scope.why: Covers the four requested behaviours; the desktop-client edits are only the type-forced provider map entries (fintegra hard-coded as not configured).

maintainability.why: The guard centralises the link rules, but it now both asserts and mutates (unlinking holders) under an assert name, and each new provider adds another full copy of the link and download code.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertNotLinkedElsewhere clears holder accounts with its own db.updateAccount block instead of reusing the local part of unlinkAccount

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains the replaceExistingLink flag, which adds a branch that turns the assertion into a mutation that unlinks the other holders; all six link functions call it
